text_block_list.text:
I happen to hear a gloomy voice coming
from the
back of the school building as
I'm walking by.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hoho? Hehe... are you in need of

Mati-kan't-get-any-luck-itaru?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
You heard that right... I've got a new
name. My
motivation, my energy, my
luck... it's all gone...
text_block_list.name: Mati-kan't-get-any-luck-itaru(?)

text_block_list.text:
The great Shiraoki did say, "The more
you run,
the more possibilities will come
upon you." But...
all this running has only
made me all weak and
floppy.
text_block_list.name: Mati-kan't-get-any-luck-itaru(?)

text_block_list.text:
None of my spells or prayers are
working. I don't
know what to do
anymore...
text_block_list.name: Mati-kan't-get-any-luck-itaru(?)

text_block_list.text:
Running back-to-back races recently is
taking its
toll on her. I'd better adjust
her race schedule...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
